content: Let P be the plane passing through the points $$(5,3,0),(13,3,-2)$$ and $$(1,6,2)$$. For $$\alpha \in \mathbb{N}$$, if the distances of the points $$\mathrm{A}(3,4, \alpha)$$ and $$\mathrm{B}(2, \alpha, a)$$ from the plane P are 2 and 3 respectively, then the positive value of a is :
